# Average Day Range

*Average high-to-low range over N bars.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Average Day Range** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `14` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/adr.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Average Day Range", shortTitle: "ADR", overlay: false });
const length = input.int("Length", 14, { min: 1 });
plot(ta.sma(ta.calc([candle.high, candle.low], (h, l) => h - l), length), { title: "ADR", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
```
